baseline: GENT NANO-24 V3.xx operating issue 9 (December 2021), installation issue 11 (January 2022); V2.xx commissioning issue 3 (May 2010) explicitly supplementary and version-limited.

validation.browserValidation: Owned by the release integration audit; this tutorial audit records pure-engine replay and source validation only.
checks: Every stored physical-key sequence is replayed literally; the test does not navigate by goal or repair missing lesson steps.
Every logical step reaches its stated outcome only on the final stored key, and every lesson reaches its final-state conditions.
Commit-event steps require fresh semantic events.
Ten abandoned-form recovery cases preserve protection state through logout, unrelated navigation, reauthentication and field reconstruction.
Wrong PIN digits and cursor positions recover through physical keys without automatic acceptance.
All source references point to actual one-based PDF pages in pinned documents.
All help cross-links and matching restoration lessons resolve.
Weekly-test completion is refused while the test remains active after timed silence/reset.
Engineering-only reference screens are excluded from executable tutorials.
The locked Cancel Buzzer prompt teaches entering access then pressing Cancel Buzzer again.

teachingContract.goals: Goal steps can take several physical presses. The controller highlights one at a time and never performs a key on the learner’s behalf.
teachingContract.expectedKeys: The complete literal key list includes the explicit final nextKey on commit steps; laboratory and acknowledgement steps have empty lists.
teachingContract.labActions: set-input, set-fault and tick are separate labelled FINDR controls, not invented Nano panel keys.
teachingContract.feedback: Completion follows actual outcome conditions; root controller supplies optional rising audio and celebration.
teachingContract.restoration: Device, zone and sector disablement lessons link the matching re-enable lesson and leave the changed state visible.
teachingContract.timers: Guided lessons pause simulation time while the learner reads and use explicit five/eight-second training actions. Free practice timers run while visible. This pause is clearly marked as a FINDR teaching convention, not a Nano feature.

limits: No physical Nano or firmware-image validation was performed.
Device status editing uses the declared optional Level 2 fixture setting documented in the older commissioning source; the V3.xx operator form itself is read-only.
The global menu ordering is supplemented from the older commissioning appendix; no universal V3.xx hardware transcript is claimed.
PIN range cycling, exact return pages and some validation wording are stated practice conventions.
The 999-record training history bound comes from V2.xx commissioning page 22; the V3.xx operator manual establishes newest-entry numbering without restating capacity.
Coincidence, printer setup and unverified engineering operations stay reference-only or configuration-dependent.
Day/night lesson uses the declared CALENDAR-mode fixture and direct Save; the V3.xx manual’s separate warning note is not turned into an invented post-save confirmation.
